Across Bayview and the newer Wellington East builds, it’s the standard job — an above ground pool or a deck coming down ahead of a renovation the family’s finally started. And wherever the address sits in town, the process stays consistent: one crew, one flat number, no guessing involved. The 700+ five-star reviews behind Live Junk Free reflect that consistency more than anything — the same standard, whichever street the job’s on.

blocks.text: DEMOLITION FAQ
Demolition Services in Aurora — What to Know Before the First Swing

items.q: How much does demolition cost in Aurora?
a: It depends on the structure — a fence section is inexpensive, a full above ground pool or a concrete pad costs more given the crew time involved. The figure is confirmed free at the walkthrough and holds to the invoice.

items.q: Do you demolish structures on larger Aurora Estates or Hills of St Andrew properties?
a: Yes — bigger lots and structures are regular work for us, with the same standard of grounds and driveway protection applied whatever the property’s scale.

items.q: How careful are you around older homes near Aurora Village?
a: Genuinely careful. Original features that stay get protected, and the work moves at a pace that respects the property’s age.

items.q: What's involved in concrete or flooring demolition?
a: The patio, walkway or driveway gets broken up with equipment matched to its thickness, then hauled off in manageable pieces. The site is left level and cleared.

items.q: Can demolition happen the same day I call?
a: Often, yes. Trucks run Aurora daily, 6AM to 11PM, seven days a week — a morning call frequently becomes an afternoon demolition.
